infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: UNDERGROUND uses your location to verify territory runs you start.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Allow Always so a run keeps recording when your phone locks. UNDERGROUND records location only between Start and End of a run or drive you begin.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: UNDERGROUND uses the camera for run finish photos and private garage media you choose to upload.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: UNDERGROUND opens your photo library only when you choose a garage photo or a run finish photo.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: UNDERGROUND may save capture evidence you approve to your photo library.
